# Recording money in the ledger

> [`LedgerService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/ledger.service.ts#L19) posts balanced double-entry journals as immutable [`LedgerEntry`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L85) rows and emits a `ledger.journal_posted` event in the same transaction.

_Part of [domain/payments](../../units/domain/payments.md)_

Money moves in the ledger as a *journal*: a group of lines, each line being an account and a signed whole-number amount in cents. Positive means money in (credit), negative means money out (debit). A journal must add up to exactly zero. [`LedgerService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/ledger.service.ts#L19) lives in `libs/domains/payments/application/ledger.service.ts` and is exported by [`LedgerModule`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/ledger.module.ts#L27). Everything goes through `LedgerService.post()`. It first checks that the lines sum to zero and that every amount is a safe integer. If not, it throws a 500 `CRITICAL: unbalanced journal`. Then it writes one [`LedgerEntry`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L85) row per non-zero line with `bulkCreate`, inside the transaction the caller passes in. Last, it records a [`JournalPosted`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/events/ledger-events.ts#L5) event (`ledger.journal_posted`) through the outbox in that same transaction. So the rows and the event commit together or not at all. The code comments say a deferred `ledger_balanced` constraint trigger in the database re-checks the sum at COMMIT as a last line of defense. That trigger is not in the files shown here. `recordMarketplaceSale()` is the sale helper. It splits a payment into three lines: the buyer is debited the full total, the merchant is credited total minus fee, and the platform revenue account is credited the fee. It uses the payment id as the journal id, so there is one `SALE` journal per payment. `balance()` gives the authoritative balance of an account by summing its entries. It is the fallback for the fast Redis balance, see [Shop balance and payout history reads](shop-balance-read-model.md).

**Look at:** [ledger.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/ledger.service.ts) · [`recordMarketplaceSale` in ledger.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/ledger.service.ts#L28) · [`LedgerEntry` in ledger-entry.model.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L79) · [`JournalPosted` in ledger-events.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/events/ledger-events.ts#L5) · [`LEDGER_ACCOUNTS` in accounts.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/domain/accounts.ts#L8) · [`LedgerModule` in ledger.module.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/ledger.module.ts#L27)

## Pieces

- [Posting one balanced journal](post-journal.md): `post()` checks the lines sum to zero, inserts one [`LedgerEntry`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L85) per non-zero line, and records the [`JournalPosted`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/events/ledger-events.ts#L5) event, all in the caller's transaction.
- [Recording a marketplace sale as a three-line journal](record-marketplace-sale.md): `recordMarketplaceSale()` debits the buyer by the total, credits the merchant total minus fee, and credits the platform the fee, using the payment id as journal id.
- [Immutable ledger entry row](ledger-entry-row.md): [`LedgerEntry`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L85) is one line of a journal: journal id, kind, optional payment id, account id and a signed `BIGINT` amount in cents; it has no update or delete timestamps.
- Journal posted event: [`JournalPosted`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/application/events/ledger-events.ts#L5) is the versioned `ledger.journal_posted` event carrying the journal kind and its lines, validated with zod.
- Chart of accounts: Constants for the named accounts: marketplace clearing, platform fees, payout clearing, and a per-shop account `SHOP_<id>` built by `shopAccount()`.
- Authoritative account balance: `balance()` sums all [`LedgerEntry`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L85) amounts for one account with raw SQL; it is the fallback and rebuild source for the Redis projection.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | [`LedgerEntry`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L85) | Insert-only table of journal lines; `balance()` sums `amount` per `accountId`. |
| event | `ledger.journal_posted` | Recorded through the outbox in the same transaction as the entries, so the balance read model and statements can follow. |

## Also relies on

- [Payment records and DTO service](payment-records.md): A [`LedgerEntry`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/models/ledger-entry.model.ts#L85) can point to a `Payment` through its optional `paymentId`.

## Watch out

- Two sets of account names exist: [`LEDGER_ACCOUNTS`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/domain/accounts.ts#L8) and `shopAccount()` in `domain/accounts.ts`, and [`SystemAccount`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/api/ledger.dto.ts#L25) and `MERCHANT_` or `USER_` ids in `api/ledger.dto.ts`. Check which one your caller uses.
- Zero-amount lines are dropped before insert, but they still count in the sum check and appear in the emitted event.
- `domainEvents` is `@Optional()`. If it is not provided, `post()` still writes the entries but silently emits no event.
- `recordMarketplaceSale()` takes a `tx` parameter but then calls `wrapInTransaction` and uses the inner `tx` it receives. Pass the caller's transaction anyway.
